title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the Act of Having Sexual Relations with a Female Child under the Age of 14 with the Consent of Both Parties, Where the Actor Did Not Know That the Female Child Was under the Age of 14, Constitutes the Crime of Rape

articles.content_en:
Judicial Interpretation [2003] No. 4
Liaoning Province Higher People's Court:
Your court's Request for Instruction regarding the issue of whether a perpetrator who has consensual sexual relations with a minor girl under the age of 14 without knowing her age constitutes the crime of rape has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
A perpetrator who knowingly has sexual relations with a minor girl under the age of 14, regardless of whether the girl is consenting, shall all be convicted and punished for the crime of rape in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 236 of the Criminal Law:
If the perpetrator truly does not know that the other party is a minor girl under the age of 14, and both parties voluntarily have sexual relations without causing serious consequences, and the circumstances are obviously minor, it shall not be deemed a crime.
This reply.
January 17, 2003
